findings.reason: the section must name the field it reads (`the ledger row's plan field`, `the live pointer's node.plan`), or the node story is written against a shape no record has and the composition never fires on the live fleet.
findings.text: "A crew run whose node names the plan" names the wrong field: in the committed run ledger (`docs/state/<project>/runs/<run>.json`) the plan is a top-level `plan` field while `node` is a bare node-id string (`docs/state/reckon/runs/r-20261027T122749032884-a-plan-review-composes-itself.json` records `plan: a-queue-holds-the-whole-plan`, `section: §21`, `node: a-plan-review-composes-itself`), and in a live pointer the plan sits at `node.plan` (`~/.config/reckon/crew/live/r-20261025T012116961947-vs1-fdu-count-citation.json`: top-level `plan: None` against `node.plan: coil-supply-report-rebuild`) — a worker that reads the section literally and matches the node string against the plan slug finds no run for any real plan, so the pass composes nothing while fixtures built from the same misreading pass

findings.reason: an ambiguous negative control can be satisfied by a mutation the arm passes under, which leaves the section claiming a discriminating measure it does not have; naming the exact bound and the fixture's run age makes the arm fail under the mutation or shows it does not.
findings.text: the declared negative control "removes the one-day bound, and the two-days arm must fail" is ambiguous between the two one-day bounds the mechanism carries (the plan-file modification upper bound and the under-a-day run age), and the two-days arm states no run age for its fixture, so on the reading where the run-age bound is the one removed — or where the two-days fixture's run is itself two days old — the arm still returns "none" and the control does not fire

findings.reason: the section's own history is a pass that composed for the wrong plans; an arm with no positive control leaves the mirror failure (composing for none) invisible, and the fix is one clause naming the plans the dry run weighed or a plan it does compose.
findings.text: the live-store arm asserts only that a timed dry run "returns within 30 s without raising" and that "every plan it would compose has a run naming it within the last day", both of which a composer whose candidate discovery finds no plan at all satisfies vacuously, so this arm cannot distinguish a working pass from the inverse of the defect the section was reverted for
